credits.title: Heysel 85
credits.overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.

credits.title: Traffic
credits.overview: Natalia and Ginel leave their small Romanian Danube village to work abroad in Rotterdam. One evening, when she is assaulted after meeting a local, Natalia asks Ita, a friend from home turned into a crook, to help her.

credits.title: Het Grote Offensief
credits.overview: The two rival Allied commanders, General Eisenhower and Field Marshal Montgomery,  clash in a battle of egos and strategic choices, with devastating consequences for the people of Zeeland during the liberation of the Netherlands.

credits.title: Duyster
credits.overview: Three students film a documentary about Johannes Duyster, Antwerp's 17th century executioner. This is their footage.

credits.title: Egg
credits.overview: A girl finds a mysterious egg in the woods and takes it home, keeping it secret from her parents, she puts it in the attic. Not knowing what consequences could be. Then, it hatches.

credits.title: The Girl with Nine Wigs
credits.overview: The true story of a young woman whose lust for life means she is determined to be so very much more than just another cancer patient.
